basis: Phase 19C reconciled production outcomes (real subsequent battles)
why_not_active: Duel could not be calibrated (38 reconciled players, 100 required), and no competitive band except 'medium' clears the 30-player support floor on held-out data. Activating would also change VERSIONS mid-collection and split the running experiment across two systems.
method: two thresholds on P(change); fitted on half the players, scored on the other half

competitive.note: Ordering holds out of sample, but only 'medium' has enough players to carry an accuracy claim. The deeper issue is score overconfidence, not the cuts: 162 of 167 predictions sit in the 0.8-1.0 confidence bin where the model says 96.7% and reality is 71.6%. Thresholds relabel; they cannot fix that.

duel.note: INTERNAL USE ONLY. No accuracy claim is published for any duel band.
